description: Search the checkrss.com directory of 1,600+ sites whose feeds the CheckRSS bot fetched and verified, including about 300 Polish sites (national and regional news, tech, business, culture). Match by name, domain, subject or country; filter by category and country. Each result has the site, its feed addresses with format, item count and newest item date, and a checkrss.com page link. Use to recommend feeds: "RSS feeds about AI", "Polish news RSS", "BBC RSS feed". Leave query empty to list the best known sites of a category or country.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Poland", "PL", "UK", "Germany".

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "security", "bbc", "krakow". May be empty.

name: search_directory
title: Search the CheckRSS feed directory
